text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Talk about intimidating!
I bet we could make tons of sushi out of this. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりすごい迫力ですね～
お寿司にしたら、何貫分でしょう♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Less fantasizing about sushi,
more focusing on taking this thing down.
It's too late to back out now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
寿司換算はやめなさいよ……
まぁでも、
ここまで来たらやるしかないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I'll be sure to protect both my lord and myself this time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
わたくしも……
今度こそは
主さまをお守りいたします。
